card.name: Linking words before lab monitoring methods
card.fires_on: Small linking words (in, the, using, by, with, from) right before a named assay, test or measuring instrument, such as aPTT, anti-Xa assay or a blood gas analyzer. Also the hyphen in "pulse-height analyzer".

modes.label: Words before a monitoring test
modes.description: A preposition or article just before the lab test or assay used to monitor a drug effect.

modes.label: Words before a measuring device
modes.description: A linking word before an analyzer or instrument that reads a value.
modes.example: falsely elevated readings of methemoglobin by<< arterial>> blood gas analyzer.

modes.label: Inside detector names
modes.description: A hyphen within a compound name for a detector or analyzer.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward the word "channel(s)", as in measurement channels, and away from "limit" words.
card.plain: It marks the small word just before the name of a lab test or measuring instrument is given.
